title: TestAtlas Adapter Capabilities
description: Per-adapter capability declarations. Each TestAtlas command declares required capabilities in its frontmatter; an adapter is allowed to render the command only if it declares all of those capabilities (or provides a capability-degradation render for the missing ones).

globalOutputPattern.description: Optional. Path of the rendered command file(s) when installed with --global, relative to the user home dir. If absent, the adapter is skipped in --global mode.

globalNotes.description: Optional human-readable note shown post-install when --global is used. Use to document any per-tool config the user must add (e.g. tool doesn't auto-discover from $HOME).
